description: Standard nursing assessment interview. Same script run through every system × every scenario so fidelity comparisons are apples-to-apples. Each question is tagged with its gold assessment domain — this doubles as part of the domain-classifier evaluation set.

questions.q: Hi, what brings you in today?
When did your symptoms start?
Can you describe the pain or discomfort for me?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is it?
Does anything make it better or worse?
Have you had any shortness of breath?
Any nausea or vomiting?
Any fever or chills?
Any headache or vision changes?
Do you have any chronic medical conditions?
Have you had any surgeries?
What medications do you take?
Do you have any drug or food allergies?
Do you smoke or use tobacco?
Do you drink alcohol?
What do you do for work?
Are there any medical conditions that run in your family?
Let me check your blood pressure and heart rate.
I'd like to check your oxygen saturation.
Thank you, that's very helpful.
